--- name: openCodeApproveSkill description: Answers an OpenCode permission (security) prompt for an agent job step. ---
# Open Code Approve
Answers an OpenCode permission (security) prompt for an agent job step.
## When to use
- A job step is waiting with status `securityprompt` and a person has decided.
## How it works
1. Loads the waiting step from `currentagentjobstepid` (posted by `agent_job_showstatus`), or falls back to `agentjobstep`. 2. Does nothing but run the children unless the step's status is `securityprompt`. 3. Sends `decision` (once, always or reject; default once) to OpenCode for the pending permission. 4. Sets the step back to `running`, clears the pending fields, and hands back to the scenario's `openCodeStatusSkill` step so progress keeps showing.
## Inputs
- `currentagentjobstepid`: Id of the runner step waiting on the prompt - `agentjobstep`: The waiting agentjobstep record, used when no id is posted - `decision`: once, always or reject
## Outputs
- The step saved as running, and a confirmation response that runs the status step next
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeApproveSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeApproveSkill` - Agent type: `eventagent`

--- name: openCodeUserRequestSkill description: Turns the chat user's message into a one-step agent job for the OpenCode runner. ---
# Open Code User Request
Turns the chat user's message into a one-step agent job for the OpenCode runner.
## When to use
- A user asks in chat for something OpenCode should do, such as editing files or building pages.
## How it works
1. Waits if there is no user message, or if it is empty. 2. Creates an `agentjob` with a single `openCodeRunnerSkill` step for the user. 3. Puts `userrequest`, `agentjob` and `agentjobstep` on the root context and runs the children.
## Inputs
- `usermessage`: The chat message from the user
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `userrequest`, `agentjob`, `agentjobstep` (on the root context)
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeUserRequestSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeUserRequestSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: openCodeAnswerSkill description: Submits a person's answers to an OpenCode question form for an agent job step. ---
# Open Code Answer
Submits a person's answers to an OpenCode question form for an agent job step.
## When to use
- A job step is waiting with status `question` and the form has been filled in.
## How it works
1. Loads the waiting step from `currentagentjobstepid` (posted by `agent_job_showstatus`), or falls back to `agentjobstep`, and reads its `pendingform`. 2. Collects one `<formid>_<fieldkey>` value per field (multiselect options post `<formid>_<fieldkey>__<option>=true`) and converts them to boolean, integer or number as the form expects. Blank fields are left out so OpenCode uses the default. 3. Sends the answer to OpenCode, sets the step back to `running`, and clears the pending fields. 4. Hands back to the scenario's `openCodeStatusSkill` step so progress keeps showing.
## Inputs
- `currentagentjobstepid`: Id of the runner step waiting on the question - `agentjobstep`: The waiting agentjobstep record, used when no id is posted - `<formid>_<fieldkey>`: One posted value per form field
## Outputs
- The step saved as running, and a confirmation response with the answer that runs the status step next
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeAnswerSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeAnswerSkill` - Agent type: `eventagent`

--- name: openCodeRunnerSkill description: Starts or resumes an OpenCode session for an agent job step, then hands it to the status step to wait on. ---
# Open Code Runner
Starts or resumes an OpenCode session for an agent job step, then hands it to the status step to wait on.
## When to use
- A job step should be carried out by the OpenCode coding agent on the server's files. - Put an `openCodeStatusSkill` step after it (`runafter`) to wait on the session, show progress, and handle questions.
## How it works
1. Connects to the OpenCode server and resumes the session saved for this step's id, or starts a new one in `workingpath` (default: the folder above the web root) with the step's `userrequest`. 2. Puts the `sessionstatus` in the context and runs the children right away. It does not wait for OpenCode.
## Inputs
- `agentjobstep`: The agentjobstep record. Its `userrequest` is the prompt sent to OpenCode - `workingpath`: Folder the OpenCode session runs in
## Outputs
- `sessionstatus`: The OpenCode session, read by `openCodeStatusSkill`
## Implementation
- Bean `openCodeRunnerSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.OpenCodeRunnerSkill` - Agent type: `eventagent`
